fullSongFeedback.scope: The listener likes the complete chord-expanded arrangement but requests the main instrument in the middle. The raw A-left/B-right presentation is not the final spatial choice.

placementClarifications: With centering the main instrument/voice you have more creative freedom to distribute the rest left and right!
Re: Centering the whole first chip >> that would be bad, not the intention of stereo
I am not saying: nothing else in center. Go ahead and center others too, if it makes sense. My point: placement must be deliberate choice
placementPrinciple: Choose each musical role’s spatial position intentionally, then allocate chip resources to support it. A stable centered lead may share the center with bass or other roles when that serves the music. Keep purposeful contrast across the accompaniment; neither automatic whole-chip centering nor a lead-only-center rule expresses the request.
